name: Victoria 3
description: Victoria 3 is a grand strategy simulation set in the Victorian era, emphasizing economy, society, and politics through a detailed population (pops) system. Players guide industrialization, diplomacy, and social reforms while managing emergent class interests, technology, and market forces.
reputation: Highly regarded Paradox title praised for deep, realistic societal and economic modeling.
notes: Strong emphasis on emergent historical alternate paths driven by player and AI decisions.
